experimental_design: T3 or vehicle control for 6 h
Nthy-ORI cells were harvested after 6 h of treatment with T3 or vehicle control, washed, and bound to activated Concanavalin A coated magnetic beads (Epicypher 21-1401).
factor_value: For T3 treatments, cells were hormone-starved for 24 h in growth media substituted with phenol-red free RPMI 1640 and charcoal-stripped fetal bovine serum (Sigma) prior to the addition of 10 nM T3 or the equivalent volume of 1 N NaOH vehicle for the indicated time course.
number_of_biological_replicates: This was repeated to collect a total of three biological replicates per condition.
technology_type: Gels were then silver stained (Pierce 24600) prior to band excision for mass spectrometry (Supplemental Figure S4C).
